elements.description:
A JSON document laid out for review – Document and Raw, one at a time or side by side, search across them, flags with notes on fields,
Copy and Download – inline or as a modal.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the viewer's name

properties.name: description
properties.description: One line under the heading; by default the document's size and how many values it holds

properties.name: value
properties.description: The document, already parsed. `source` is used when this is undefined

properties.name: source
properties.description: The document as JSON text, parsed when `value` isn't given; a syntax error is shown where it is

properties.name: view
properties.description: The view shown. Changed by the user unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: layout
properties.description: "tabs" shows one view at a time; "split" shows the rendered view beside the raw JSON. Switched by the user unless tc-layout-change is prevented

properties.name: layoutToggle
properties.description: Whether the toolbar offers the switch between tabs and side by side

properties.name: filter
properties.description: What the search box holds. Changed by the user unless tc-filter-change is prevented

properties.name: flags
properties.description: The reviewer's flags. Changed by the user unless tc-flags-change is prevented

properties.name: keyStyle
properties.description: How Document names fields: "words" ("Invoice date") or "raw" (the key as written)

properties.name: filename
properties.description: The name Download saves the file under

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for numbers and dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: modal
properties.description: Show it as a dialog, opened by `open`

properties.name: open
properties.description: With `modal`: whether the dialog is showing. Escape and Close ask to close (tc-open-change)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-view-change
events.description: The view changed ({ view }: JsonViewerViewChange); cancelable – prevented, `view` stays as it was

events.name: tc-layout-change
events.description: Tabs or side by side was switched ({ layout }: JsonViewerLayoutChange); cancelable – prevented, `layout` stays as it was

events.name: tc-filter-change
events.description: The search changed ({ filter }: JsonViewerFilterChange); cancelable – prevented, `filter` stays as it was

events.name: tc-flags-change
events.description: A flag was added, edited or removed ({ flags, path, note }: JsonViewerFlagsChange); cancelable – prevented, `flags` stays as it was

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: With `modal`: asks to open or close ({ open }: JsonViewerOpenChange), from Escape or Close; cancelable – prevented, `open` stays

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: The JSON was copied ({ text }: JsonViewerCopy); cancelable – prevented, nothing is copied

events.name: tc-download
events.description: Download was pressed ({ filename, text }: JsonViewerDownload); cancelable – prevented, the page saves it its own way

functions.name: valueAt
functions.description: The value at a JSON Pointer, or undefined

functions.name: keyWords
functions.description: A key in plain words: "invoice_date", "invoiceDate" and "invoice-date" all read "Invoice date"; "vendor_id" reads "Vendor ID"

functions.name: firstJsonError
functions.description: Where JSON text first goes wrong, as an offset – a small scanner, for browsers whose messages don't say; -1 when it's valid

functions.name: errorPosition
functions.signature: errorPosition(text: string, message: string): { line: number; column: number } | null
functions.description: A JSON syntax error's position in the text: 1-based line and column, from the browser's message or found by scanning

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the viewer's name

props.name: view
props.description: The view shown – controlled when given

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The view on mount when `view` isn't controlled

props.name: layout
props.description: One view at a time ("tabs") or the rendered view beside the raw JSON ("split") – controlled when given

props.name: defaultLayout
props.description: The layout on mount when `layout` isn't controlled

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: The layout was switched with the toolbar button

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: The search on mount when `filter` isn't controlled

props.name: flags
props.description: The reviewer's flags – controlled when given: adding, editing and removing report the next list

props.name: defaultFlags
props.description: The flags on mount when `flags` isn't controlled

props.name: onFlagsChange
props.type: (next: JsonFlag[], change: { path: string; note: string | null }) => void
props.description: A flag was added, edited or removed; `next` is the list as it will be

props.name: open
props.description: With `modal`: whether the dialog is showing – controlled when given; pair it with onOpenChange

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: With `modal`: whether an uncontrolled dialog starts open

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: With `modal`: the dialog asks to open or close (Escape, Close)

props.name: onCopyJson
props.description: The JSON was copied; `event.preventDefault()` stops the copy

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Download was pressed; `event.preventDefault()` to save it your own way

changelog: **JSON Viewer** (`tc-json-viewer`) – a JSON document laid out for someone to check: Document reads it like a form (keys in plain words, nested objects as sections, lists of like objects as tables, links, dates and yes/no drawn as what they are) and Raw is the pretty-printed JSON with line numbers; `layout="split"` shows them side by side, each field linked to its lines. Search marks and counts matches in every view; reviewers flag fields with notes (`tc-flags-change`); Copy and Download hand over the JSON – `source` as written, so integers too big to hold exactly (which are marked) keep their digits. `source` text that isn't valid JSON shows where it breaks. With `modal`, it's a dialog opened by `open`.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: <dialog> and showModal()
features.why: Modals trap focus, close on Escape and sit in the top layer.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
